name: M5 socket-head cap screw (DIN 912 envelope)
summary: Thread-free M5 socket-head cap screw envelope: 8.5 mm head dia x 5 mm high, 5 mm shank, 4 mm hex socket. Origin on the head bearing face, shank along -Z.
preview: M5 SHCS envelope, head 8.5x5 mm, shank 5 mm, length 8-50 mm (default 16)

length.doc: shank length below the head, mm

component.frame: head bearing face; head spans 0..+k in Z, shank runs -Z
simplifications: no under-head fillet or washer face
hex socket is a straight prism, not a broached form
